mechanism: Prednisolone may reduce the antihypertensive and cardioprotective effects of sacubitril through fluid retention, sodium reabsorption, and increased cardiac workload; sacubitril is an ARNI that depends on ACE inhibition and neprilysin inhibition for therapeutic benefit.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and consider prednisolone dose minimization or alternative anti-inflammatory agents; assess for signs of heart failure exacerbation during concurrent use.
